cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Fine. Whose proposal will you call that in the meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And when Morgan and I both claim you supported us, which one will you correct?

mechanism: A grades a pupil mixed recommendation until the pupil must name which competing leader it will support publicly.
confusable: Not seeking a useful compromise: A makes the pupil choose allegiance after accepting mixed content.
comparison: Proposal authorship at meeting versus ribbon choice on voting day.
seedUse: D58 workshop/location/budget/compromise; S05 turns mixed answer into lesson on choosing sides.
